changes.title: Version 2.0.0
changes.summary: The data holds 481 records. One flag column is no longer in the files. 8 columns (such as receiptsUsd and payrollUsd) are now in law-firm-economy-values.csv, as id, column and value rows; join it to law-firm-economy.csv on id.

changes.title: First release
changes.summary: Law firms (NAICS 541110) by employment size for the US, every state and DC from the Census Bureau's Statistics of U.S. Businesses 2022, nonemployer (solo) legal-services businesses from Nonemployer Statistics 2024, and firms, receipts and concentration from the Economic Census 2022.
